cohort: Twin pregnancies at a University Teaching Hospital in Ile-Ife, Nigeria, over two time periods (2005-2011 and 2012-2018)
finding: The prevalence of twin births in Ile-Ife, Nigeria, showed a fluctuating decline over a 14-year period.
mod_finding: Twin II neonates born through Caesarean section were more frequently admitted to neonatal intensive care units than Twin I.
